newsitem.title: USA: ZAG sees Q2 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: ZAG sees Q2 results below estimates.

text.p: Israeli-based ZAG Industries Ltd said that its second quarter and annual sales and earnings are expected to be below Wall Street estimates.
The company is expecting second quarter sales to be aproximately $13.5 million, compared to sales of $11.8 million in the year ago quarter, ZAG said in a statement on Wednesday.
Three analysts that follow the company, which conducted an initial public stock offering in November 1996, had a consensus earnings estimate of $0.25 for the second quarter, according to First Call.
ZAG, a maker of plastic goods, anticipates 1997 sales to be $64 million, an increase of 27 percent from 1996's $50.5 million.
Analysts estimated that the company would earn $1.14 a share in 1997, compared with $0.98 a share in 1996, First Call said.
ZAG said the introduction of some product lines were delayed by five to eight weeks and certain pricing pressures in Europe have hurt results.
New products should continue to increase the company's year-to-year sales by 25 percent, ZAG said.
